title: RAS marking, labelling and installation-record spec
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. RAS §6 lists marking fields briefly. Installers and inspectors need a precise marking format and an installation record. Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Specify anchor marking (content, format, durability), the RAS-2/RAS-3 grade label, the operator indicator legend, and an installation and inspection record template.
acceptanceCriteria: Fields cover RAS §6 and §4.4 torque marking
Record template covers fastener torque, inspection interval and sign-off
No trademark claims beyond those in licensing-model.md
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
